name: SPA conditioned repeated consequence credit v1
question: Does statewise target conditioning improve acquired conditional sentence-action choices at fixed perception, capacity, order, reward and fitting budget?
causal_axis: Target conditioning changes gradient amplitude and relative state weighting together.

body.architecture: 128-wide, two-layer, four-head RoPE/RMSNorm/SwiGLU transformer; hidden 384; 94 Unicode characters; context 64
body.numerical_engine: upstream notorch.c linked with the independent C experiment runner

training.floor_reason: Selected from exposed training outcomes only: cap amplification at approximately1000 and retain near-tie magnitude below the floor. The floor activates on one training state.
training.order: seed42 snapshots0..23 then seed73 snapshots0..23, same order every epoch
training.initial: Fresh native seed1 life, zero online history. Each fitted arm begins independently from this exact life.
training.raw_control: fit_repeated unchanged. Must reproduce parent mean8_h4 canonical life exactly before evaluation.
training.dataset_reuse: Use retained parent samples byte-equivalently; only the outer protocol identity is relabelled. No training body generation.

shuffle.group: Identical(sentence_count,target index), preserving typed action coordinates and mask.
shuffle.order: Original global training row order within each group.
shuffle.donor: The next row in the group with cyclic wraparound: donor_index=(receiver_index+1)mod group_size.
shuffle.transform: Keep receiver features and feature-source identity; copy all8 fullH4 comparisons from the donor and bind each training-input source field to the receiver. Retain donor identities and every raw outcome record separately.
shuffle.question: Does correct association of a sentence state with its future outcomes improve selection beyond acquired action preferences?

conditioning.reward_mean: Compute each consequence reward using existing native float component arithmetic, double weighted sum, float cast and clipping to[-1,1]. Accumulate those clipped float rewards in double in replicate order and cast the mean to float for each action. Target is float(mean_reward[action]-mean_reward[KEEP]). Never average raw axes before reward clipping.
conditioning.loss: mean Huber delta1 across valid heads; same native simultaneous SGD and parameter bounds[-8,8]
conditioning.receipt: Raw native mean rewards, normalized targets, floor, actual double scale, pre/post scores and losses remain separate.
conditioning.preserved: Raw reward signs and within-state measured best-action ranking; all ordinary online state and canonical v1 encoding.

generation.initial_prompt_selection: SplitMix64 samples the sorted corpus sentence-start offsets (first character and the character after .!? followed by whitespace); choose 16 following codepoints.
generation.base_chain: Generate the complete four-sentence chain once per episode and seed; clone it into every arm before intervention. Store every generated token and termination flag.
generation.rng: Independent SplitMix64 generation stream per episode/slot. Reseeds use the same per-seed/episode/decision stream in every arm. Policy RNG is separate.

evaluation.state_source: Unchanged spa_agent_demo learned-arm ordinary trajectory with diagnostics enabled. The policy under evaluation reads captured features; the reference host retains its existing online behavior.
evaluation.readout: Pure native score_experience on identical captured source29features, same masks and KEEP-first ties. Each of the two sealed fitting copies is scored; every readout/life byte must match.
evaluation.seal_before_generation: All8 canonical lives, both compressed fitting journals and training dataset/source/input/binary identities sealed before any509/601 body process.
evaluation.primary: Mean paired H4 raw native reward advantage over KEEP on48newstates,8continuations perstate. Compare associated conditioned with raw_mean8 and shuffled_conditioned.
secondary: all7raw axes and normalized generation cost
training fit and positive/negative alternative decisions
evaluation.sample_unit: 48source states nested in12episodes/two seeds;8draws are repeated outcomes, not384independent states.
evaluation.exposure: Seeds42/73 and earlier eval101/211/307/401 are exposed.509/601 absent from previous SPA protocols before this freeze.
evaluation.known_geometry: Target3 H4 continuation overwrites the initial intervention before reading it. Report cost-only outcomes separately.

replication.source: Restore the exact imported sentence chain, reseed counts, captured29features, source identities, and RNG witnesses for each source and initial action. No reconstruction claim for the unavailable original online agent struct.
replication.paired: Precompute each (source,replicate,hop) start RNG outside the action loop. Every valid initial action shares that start. Each future hop has its own independently constructed start, regardless of earlier consumption.

continuation.horizon_meaning: Number of additional fixed host reseeds after the initial intervention; horizon 0 is its immediate consequence.
continuation.future_action: RESEED_LEFT if future_target>0; otherwise RESEED_RIGHT. This is a frozen diagnostic host continuation and performs no agent learning.
continuation.future_host_rng: stream(seed, 0x7370615f66757472, episode_index*4 + decision_index, hop), independently constructed at every hop and identical across initial alternatives.
continuation.generation: The same parent 3-character-neighbor, min 12/max 64, temperature 0.8 recipe at every hop.

replication.measurements: Retain complete H0,H1,H4 token chains, termination, RNG consumption, seven raw axes and cumulative cost. Fit H4 only.
replication.native_aggregation: Compute each consequence reward using existing native float component arithmetic, double weighted sum, float cast and clipping to[-1,1]. Accumulate those clipped float rewards in double in replicate order and cast the mean to float for each action. Target is float(mean_reward[action]-mean_reward[KEEP]). Never average raw axes before reward clipping.
replication.count1: Native fit_repeated with count1 delegates to fit_comparison exactly, including receipt and state bytes.
replication.one_update: Exactly one simultaneous native mean-Huber SGD update per state per epoch, regardless of replicate count.

measurement.cost: Cumulative generated characters / (64*(horizon+1)), exactly the parent host.
measurement.primary: Across48 new source states, mean paired H4 advantage over KEEP averaged across r0..7. Compare conditioned_mean8 with raw_mean8, initial/KEEP and shuffled_conditioned.
secondary: Separate r0 and r1..7 mean paired advantage
Measured-best choices and mean regret against per-state mean8 best valid action
Each raw axis and generation cost separately, including chosen-minus-KEEP differences
Action counts, per-seed and per-target tables
Within-state sample variance of paired action-minus-KEEP reward over8replicates; paired standard error sqrt(variance/8)
Between-state variance of each mean paired advantage; sign disagreements across replicates
Selected-action source and raw outcome identity joins for every arm
Training results reported separately from new-state results
measurement.sample_unit: 48 source states, nested in two generation seeds. The384 state/replicate combinations are repeated outcomes, not384 independent states.
measurement.reward_precision: Report native clipped rewards and targets as authoritative; any independent arithmetic check names its tolerance.

execution.source_host: Unchanged spa_agent_demo OFF/ON diagnostics paired for each seed; full ordinary trace and5lives byte-identical.
execution.repeated_host: Unchanged spa_agent_replicates, one K8 trajectory set per new source state; complete r0 parent lines must agree.
execution.scope: No search over rates/epochs/seeds/capacity/reward/floor after fitting or new outcomes. Retain result whether benefit, regression or unchanged choices.
execution.raw_journal: Every native fit receipt/source/donor/policy identity retained in a verified gzip stream. Seal compressed and decoded identities before publication.
execution.archive: Create-only gzip archive with all raw evaluation/source traces, both fitting journals, datasets, readouts, seals and recorded commands/identities. Exclude model weights and life checkpoints from repository.
